title: FY2025 one-time legal settlement is recurring in history; management adjusted EBITDA includes a non-recurring add-back
finding: The management QoE schedule adds back a $2.1M FY2025 'One-time legal settlement' as non-recurring. Board minutes describe the FY2025 item as 'the third annual settlement' in an ongoing series, and the structured adjustment table shows the same category and amount in FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025. Under method M1, the EV impact is the rejected adjustment amount multiplied by the 11.935484x entry multiple from deal settings and management adjusted EBITDA.

evidence.quote: the third annual settlement under the ongoing series of commercial disputes

evidence.sql: SELECT category, fiscal_year, amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment ORDER BY category, fiscal_year

mitigation: Remove the add-back from the price basis and obtain settlement agreements and FY2026 legal papers before closing.
what_would_raise_confidence: Executed settlement agreements, legal invoices, and FY2026 board/legal papers showing whether another settlement was expected or accrued.
ev_method_explained: EV impact equals negative rejected adjustment amount times entry multiple: -$2.1M x 11.935484x = -$25.064516M, from SQL.

title: Northwind change-of-control consent and termination right contradict management's free-assignability claim
finding: The executed Northwind MSA treats a supplier change of control as an assignment requiring prior written consent, and allows termination if closing occurs without consent. The same contract also expires three months after the stated 31 March 2026 close with no auto-renewal, while management's contract summary says 'None noted' for change-of-control restriction. Under method M2, EV impact is ARR at risk multiplied by 40% contribution margin, 35% loss probability for consent plus termination risk, and the 11.935484x entry multiple.

evidence.section: Section 14.2 Assignment and Change of Control
evidence.quote: Change of Control of Supplier shall constitute an assignment
Customer may terminate this Agreement on ninety (90) days' written notice

evidence.sql: SELECT ROUND(-1 * 10547040.61 * 0.40 * 0.35 * (148000000 / 12400000), 0) AS northwind_ev_impact_usd, ROUND((-1 * 10547040.61 * 0.40 * 0.35 * (148000000 / 12400000)) / 12400000, 2) AS northwind_turns, ROUND(100 * 10547040.61 / 38662136.43, 1) AS northwind_share_pct, months_between(DATE'2026-06-30', DATE'2026-03-31') AS northwind_months_after_close

mitigation: Seek consent before signing or make the customer outreach plan a gated workstream before close.
what_would_raise_confidence: Signed consent correspondence from Northwind or confirmation no amendment supersedes Sections 14.2 and 14.3.
ev_method_explained: EV impact equals negative ARR at risk times contribution margin times loss probability times entry multiple: -$10.54704061M x 0.40 x 0.35 x 11.935484 = -$17.623765M, from SQL. Loss probability uses the default assumption for consent needed on change of control with termination right if not given.
for_counsel: What consent process, if any, is required before signing or closing a sale transaction involving Harborline under Section 14.2 and 14.3?

title: FY2025 pro-forma full-year effect of new logos is unsupported and includes a re-engagement labelled as new
finding: Management adds back $1.65M for a pro-forma full-year effect of FY2025 new logos, but the QoE schedule itself says the item is an annualisation of in-year wins rather than FY2025 historical earnings. The executed Cascade agreement states the customer previously contracted under a 2021 MSA before re-engagement, while management's contract summary labels Cascade a 'New logo win FY2025', undermining the reliability of the narrative used in the adjustment. Under method M1, EV impact is the challenged adjustment amount multiplied by the 11.935484x entry multiple, and the item should be excluded from team EBITDA pending evidence.

evidence.quote: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
Customer was previously party to a Master Services Agreement with Supplier dated 1 March 2021

mitigation: Remove the annualisation from price-basis EBITDA and require a customer-level annualisation bridge if management wants any partial credit.
what_would_raise_confidence: Customer-level annualization model, gross margin/EBITDA conversion support, booking-to-revenue bridge, and clear evidence separating true new logos from reactivations/re-engagements.
ev_method_explained: EV impact equals negative challenged adjustment amount times entry multiple: -$1.65M x 11.935484x = -$19.693548M, from SQL. The item is pro-forma rather than historical EBITDA and is excluded from team EBITDA pending evidence.

title: Vantage MFN clause may require pricing step-down and retrospective credits after Pinnacle's 34% discount
finding: The executed Vantage MSA says its 18% discount must remain no less favourable than discounts granted to any other comparable customer and requires retrospective application from the date the better discount was first granted. The executed Pinnacle contract grants a 34% discount, and SQL shows Pinnacle's ACV meets the Vantage clause's 50% comparability threshold; board minutes record that counsel asked for the Vantage MFN provision to be reviewed in light of the Pinnacle pricing. Under method M3, annual credit equals Vantage latest ARR multiplied by the discount differential formula, back-credit equals invoiced amounts since 14 March 2025 multiplied by the same differential, and EV impact equals negative annual credit times the 11.935484x entry multiple plus back-credit; turns are not supported by the recorded SQL because the turns query failed.

evidence.quote: retrospectively from the date such discount was first granted to the other customer
Supplier grants a discount of thirty-four per cent (34%) against list pricing

evidence.sql: SELECT b.contract_id AS other_contract_id, b.customer_id AS other_customer_id, b.discount_pct AS other_discount_pct, b.acv_usd AS other_acv_usd, a.discount_pct AS vantage_discount_pct, a.acv_usd AS vantage_acv_usd, b.acv_usd >= 0.5 * a.acv_usd AS comparable FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract a JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract b ON a.contract_id <> b.contract_id WHERE a.contract_id = 'CTR-00002' AND b.discount_pct > a.discount_pct ORDER BY b.discount_pct DESC

SELECT ROUND(4681407.34 * ((0.34 - 0.18)/(1 - 0.18)), 2) AS annual_credit_usd, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS vantage_invoiced_since_2025_03_14 FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice WHERE customer_id='CUST-0002' AND to_date(invoice_date) >= DATE'2025-03-14'

mitigation: Quantify the credit exposure with billing, obtain any waiver or amendment, and hold pricing approvals on comparable accounts until reviewed.
what_would_raise_confidence: The full Vantage pricing schedule, any MFN exceptions, and billing/credit history showing whether Harborline already assessed or satisfied the clause after the 14 March 2025 Pinnacle approval.
ev_method_explained: Annual credit from SQL is $913,445.56 using Vantage ARR and the discount formula (d2-d1)/(1-d1). Back-credit from SQL uses $3,912,240.68 of invoiced amount since 14 March 2025. EV impact from SQL equals negative annual credit times 11.935484x plus back-credit, or -$11.665779M.
for_counsel: Does Pinnacle count as a 'customer of comparable annual committed spend' under Sections 8.4 and 8.5, and if so from what date would any retrospective credit run?

title: Vantage service instability triggered escalation and places renewal under review
finding: Board minutes state that Vantage's executive sponsor invoked the MSA escalation provision and placed the FY2027 renewal under active review. The executed Vantage MSA provides a termination path if availability falls below 99.0% in any two consecutive months, and the ticket data shows 6 Severity 1 incidents in the worst rolling three-month window against a threshold of more than 4, while management's contract summary calls the account 'Stable'. Under method M2, EV impact is ARR at risk multiplied by 40% contribution margin, 30% loss probability for renewal under review and escalation invoked, and the 11.935484x entry multiple.

evidence.quote: has invoked the escalation provision of the MSA and has placed the FY2027 renewal "under active review"
Where the number of Severity 1 incidents exceeds four (4) in any rolling three (3) month period

evidence.sql: SELECT m.month_start, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS sev1_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', to_date(opened_date)) AS month_start FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-0002') m JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket t ON t.customer_id = 'CUST-0002' AND t.severity = 'S1' AND to_date(t.opened_date) >= m.month_start AND to_date(t.opened_date) < add_months(m.month_start, 3) GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY sev1_count DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(-1 * 4681407.34 * 0.40 * 0.30 * (148000000 / 12400000), 0) AS vantage_sla_ev_impact_usd, ROUND((-1 * 4681407.34 * 0.40 * 0.30 * (148000000 / 12400000)) / 12400000, 2) AS vantage_sla_turns, ROUND(100 * 4681407.34 / 38662136.43, 1) AS vantage_share_pct, months_between(DATE'2026-12-31', DATE'2026-03-31') AS vantage_months_after_close

mitigation: Obtain the customer retention plan, service remediation plan and any customer notices before close.
spa_protection: escrow or holdback sized to the risk
what_would_raise_confidence: Monthly uptime calculations for Vantage and any customer escalation notices or cure communications.
ev_method_explained: EV impact equals negative ARR at risk times contribution margin times loss probability times entry multiple: -$4.68140734M x 0.40 x 0.30 x 11.935484 = -$6.704983M, from SQL. Loss probability uses the default assumption for renewal under review and escalation invoked.
for_counsel: Given Section 12.2 and 12.3, what contractual remedies were available to Vantage based on the measured incident pattern and any separate availability calculations?

title: Legacy On-Prem discontinued product-line add-back is unsupported by product data
finding: Management includes a $540k add-back for losses on a 'Legacy On-Prem product' being sunset. SQL product testing returned zero rows for product names, families or delivery models containing 'Legacy' or 'On-Prem', and no product sunset evidence was provided in the data room. Under method M1, EV impact is the rejected adjustment amount multiplied by the 11.935484x entry multiple, and the adjustment should be excluded from team EBITDA pending evidence.

evidence.quote: Trading losses on the Legacy On-Prem product, which is being sunset.

evidence.sql: WITH product_2025 AS ( SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_family, p.delivery_model, SUM(CAST(il.line_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)) AS fy2025_revenue_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date)) = 2025 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_family, p.delivery_model ) SELECT * FROM product_2025 WHERE lower(product_name) LIKE '%legacy%' OR lower(product_family) LIKE '%legacy%' OR lower(product_name) LIKE '%on-prem%' OR lower(delivery_model) LIKE '%on-prem%' ORDER BY fy2025_revenue_usd DESC

mitigation: Exclude the add-back unless management produces a product P&L, SKU mapping and formal sunset plan.
what_would_raise_confidence: Product P&L, SKU mapping for the legacy on-prem line, formal sunset/exit plan, and evidence of the costs embedded in reported EBITDA.
ev_method_explained: EV impact equals negative challenged adjustment amount times entry multiple: -$0.54M x 11.935484x = -$6.445161M, from SQL.

title: Weighted collection days exceed the claimed 45 days, indicating a working-capital drag
finding: The claims scoreboard computed FY2025 Q4 weighted collection days at 53.8 versus the CIM claim that DSO is approximately 45 days. Using the working-capital method, excess days are 8.8 and claim-year revenue is $42.73007329M, producing a cash tie-up of $1.030205M. This is a dollar-for-dollar normalised working-capital adjustment under method M5 rather than a multiple-based valuation item.

evidence.quote: receivables from the three largest customers had extended materially during the year

evidence.sql: SELECT concat(year(to_date(i.invoice_date)), '-Q', quarter(to_date(i.invoice_date))) AS q, ROUND(AVG(c.days_outstanding), 1) AS avg_days, ROUND(SUM(c.days_outstanding * i.invoice_amount_usd) / SUM(i.invoice_amount_usd), 1) AS weighted_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection c JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON c.invoice_id = i.invoice_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

mitigation: Reset the working-capital peg and request customer-level collections remediation for the top accounts.
what_would_raise_confidence: A true AR balance ledger or due-date based DSO schedule, because the data room supports weighted collection days more directly than full traditional DSO.
ev_method_explained: Cash tied up equals negative excess days times FY2025 revenue divided by 365: -(53.8 - 45.0) x $42.73007329M / 365 = -$1.030205M, from SQL. This is a dollar-for-dollar normalised working-capital adjustment with no EBITDA multiple.
